newsitem.title: USA: CME Dec S&P 500 futures fall initial 12-pt limit.
newsitem.headline: CME Dec S&P 500 futures fall initial 12-pt limit.

text.p: December Standard & Poor's (S&P) 500 futures traded at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) fell the 12-point initial price limit on Wednesday.

December S&P 500 futures fell 12 points to 736.00 near the opening of pit trading after touching that level during overnight elctronic trading. The contract ended electronic trading down more than 10.00 points.
Under CME rules, the 12-point down limit is in effect for 15 minutes. A two-minute trading halt would occur if prices were locked limit-offered at the end of that 15-minute period.
The 12-point down limit is not effective at 1430 CST/2030 GMT. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
